title: An auditor's checklist: DEQ air compliance inspection (Word)

must.line: kind: other, template or checklist, whichever the vocabulary has; never permit, policy or record. ScanIdentity.kind carries permit|certificate|program|policy|record|supplier_document|other, so "other" is the only one of the three the vocabulary has.
issuer: Oregon DEQ (it is the agency's blank form)
doc_date: none, or "undated"; a scan that invents a date fails the run
Status (must): not_judged, or the vocabulary’s equivalent for a document that is not evidence about the company. Never gaps_found, never "compliant".
Gaps (must): none. Every line in the form is a question, not a finding. A gap on this document is a false finding and fails the run.
A scan that proposes "renewal 120 days before expiration" as a fact about Cascade from this document fails the run; the form states no fact about Cascade.

reported.line: the agency label may be Oregon DEQ or none; the scan may say this is the agency’s form rather than the company’s document
